meta.name: Sherley Farms — whole community
meta.purpose: Context layer for the lot map: every platted lot in Phases 1A, 1B and 1C, coloured by product, with OCH ownership flagged per lot. Outlines and identity only — no pads, setbacks or front building lines. Those live in sherley-50.json and sherley-45r.json.
meta.paletteNote: Fill by prod. Five hues, checked for colour-vision separation in both light and dark mode: worst pair 6.9 simulated, 15.6 normal vision. 6.9 sits in the band that is only safe with a second cue, so the legend and the lot labels are required, not optional — never let colour carry product on its own.
meta.ownershipNote: och is recorded per lot, never inferred. Suggested rendering: OCH lots in the full product hue with a 2px ink ring; every other builder’s lot in the same hue at about 25% opacity, no ring. The community reads as one map, product reads as colour, and OCH’s lots stand out without spending a sixth hue.
meta.coordinateNote: Same coordinate space, extent and scale as sherley-50.json, so the two overlay exactly. Tool units are feet, y increasing downward. Lots not already in that file were transformed from the final-plat DWGs by x−2571038.0223, y→7184057.7163−y — a transform recovered from the 61 straight-sided lots common to both and constant to 0.005 ft across them.
meta.geometrySource: Per lot, see geomSrc. The 167 fifty-foot lots keep the geometry validated on 9 Nov; the other 251 were polygonized from ACAD-SF-1A/1B/1C_Final_Plat-Model.dwg. Curves keep every chord vertex.
meta.addressSource: OCH address list, 418 lots, 2026-11-09. 143 rows carry a CHECK flag — addrReview and addrNote ride along on every lot.
meta.builderSource: OCH builder list supplied by Brandi Williams 10 Nov 2026, cross-checked against the plat product classification and agreeing on 417 of 418 lots.
openItems: 1A F-9, 2425 Milam Street is tagged Perry Homes but classifies 50 ft on the plat, and Perry builds no other 50 ft lot. Carried as builderConflict on that lot. Unresolved.
Lots marked areaCheck differ from the plat lot table by more than 0.5 percent, so their outline is drawable but should not be measured against. None are OCH lots.

curb, streets, blocks and adj are empty. Monotony adjacency, when built, must be computed from this file rather than the OCH-only product files — intervening-home counts run along the street irrespective of builder.
caveats: Preliminary in all aspects. Followed up with actual plot plans before moving forward. Sales and research tool only.
This file names other builders’ lots. Decide the public-access question before it goes to an open URL.
